concern_results.conclusion: The classifier now greps both stderr and an extracted top-level error/*.failed event-message file with the added `usage limit` pattern, so event-stream-only quota and auth failures reach the intended quota/provider_unavailable codes with cascade_eligible true while the failure-branch order, reason codes, and stderr behavior are otherwise unchanged; the diff matches each acceptance row and the traced stub fixtures (usage_limit_event, usage_limit_turn_failed, auth_event, quota_in_model_output) exercise exactly those paths.

The classifier input is restricted to top-level error/*.failed events so nested item content quoting the untrusted packet cannot forge a verdict; the receipt carries a constant diagnostic string plus a home-elided, physically-resolved run-dir path with a separator-only home rejected as an elision needle, so no run-derived text, credential shape, URL query, or raw home path can reach a committed receipt, and the preserved directory is the pre-existing 0700 mktemp dir holding only what the in-flight run already held.

Extraction fails soft (OSError/malformed lines yield an empty transport-errors file and grep still sees stderr), every exit taken in the run_rc!=0 branch now sets PRESERVE_RUN_ROOT before die_inconclusive so the EXIT trap cannot delete the streams on any classified or terminal failure, and the successful path is untouched; the only gap, the signal-trap operator-interrupt path still deleting the run directory, is the pre-existing behavior outside the transport-failure class and not material.

The new rows fail on the unchanged wrapper for the named reasons (event-stream classification, packet-derived refusal, constant-diagnostic equality, run-dir preservation and mode, trailing-slash and separator-only home elision, success-receipt key absence), equality-with-constant assertions cannot be subverted by fixture content or a dead fixture, and the claimed RED baseline plus per-predicate mutation probes are consistent with the predicates the diff actually adds.

emit_inconclusive only appends optional positionals defaulting to empty so existing call sites and the success receipt are byte-identical in behavior, no flag, exit code, or reason code changed, and the new shell (quoted-heredoc extraction outside any command substitution, pwd -P, quoted case patterns) is Bash 3.2-parseable with the prior apostrophe-in-heredoc pitfall avoided by construction.

The change is additive and local to one wrapper with no schema, gate, or consumer contract edits, receipts gain two keys only on transport failure which review_gate.py relays uninterpreted, preserved run dirs are reclaimed by normal temp lifetime, and reverting the commit restores prior behavior with no migration or persisted state.

The original defect was failure evidence being destroyed by the EXIT trap; now every transport-failure receipt names the preserved run directory containing both captured streams while the diagnostic field is a constant pointer, which is what allowed the packet-size hypothesis to be refuted and keeps any future misclassification diagnosable from the receipt alone.
